Model Nr Ptr Pointer to the memory where the Manufacturer's Model Number shall be stored. Revision Nr Ptr Pointer to the memory where the Revision Number shall be stored. Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: organizationally unique identifier of the Ethernet transceiver could be read. E_ NOT_ OK : organizationally unique identifier of the Ethernet transceiver could not be obtained (i.e. OUI is not available). Description This function retrieves the OUI (24 bit) of the indexed Ethernet switch port. Available via Eth If.h
